places-barranc-de-l-infern-conj-2-abric-.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-barranc-de-l-infern-conj-2-abric-.story: From Pego it runs 214 km to Pego; allow about 3 h 54 of riding. The stops in between: Garganta de la Hoz I, Abric de la Penya and Barranc de l'Infern Conj. 2. The line favours views over speed.
